source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 22 exercise hal (PDF 98-100): 10 MCQs key ke saath, 5 short (hisson ke saath), 6 constructed response aur 4 descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Hydroxy Compounds) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Structures lafzon mein bayan kiye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Which compound can be oxidised to form (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₃?
(Kis compound ki oxidation se (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₃ banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₃ ketone hai (3-methylbutan-2-one). Ketone usi dhanche wale secondary alcohol ki oxidation se banta hai: (CH₃)₂CH–CH(OH)–CH₃ (3-methylbutan-2-ol) + [O] → (CH₃)₂CH–CO–CH₃ + H₂O. (a) aur (b) primary hain (aldehyde dete hain); (c) tertiary hai (oxidise nahi hota).

blocks.prompt:
II. Which alcohol forms a mixture of alkenes when dehydrated?
(Kaun sa alcohol dehydration par alkenes ka mixture deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pentan-2-ol, CH₃–CH(OH)–CH₂CH₂CH₃, mein –OH wale carbon ke do mukhtalif β-carbons (C1 aur C3) par hydrogen hai, is liye pani do tarah nikal sakta hai: pent-1-ene aur pent-2-ene. Propan-1-ol aur propan-2-ol sirf propene dete hain; pentan-1-ol pent-1-ene deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Which alcohol can be oxidised by acidified potassium dichromate(VI) but cannot be dehydrated by heating with concentrated sulfuric acid?
(Kaun sa alcohol acidified potassium dichromate(VI) se oxidise ho sakta hai magar conc. sulfuric acid se dehydrate nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: 2,2-dimethylpropan-1-ol, (CH₃)₃C–CH₂OH, primary alcohol hai, is liye dichromate ise oxidise karta hai. Is ka β-carbon teen CH₃ groups se juda hai aur us par hydrogen nahi, is liye H₂O nahi nikal sakta. (a) aur (c) tertiary hain (oxidise nahi hote); (d) secondary hai aur dehydrate ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
IV. Which one of the following mechanisms is not involved in the reaction sequence below?
CH₃CH₃ → CH₃CH₂Cl → CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂ = CH₂ → CH₃CH₂Br
(Neeche diye gaye reactions ke silsile mein kaun sa mechanism shamil nahi?)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CH₃ → CH₃CH₂Cl: free-radical substitution (Cl₂, roshni).
CH₃CH₂Cl → CH₃CH₂OH: nucleophilic substitution (aqueous NaOH).
CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂: elimination (dehydration).
CH₂=CH₂ → CH₃CH₂Br: HBr ki electrophilic addition.
Electrophilic substitution (arenes ka reaction) shamil nahi.

blocks.prompt:
V. Which one of the following does not represent an oxidation?
(In mein se kaun si tabdeeli oxidation nahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanal → ethanol reduction hai (hydrogen ka izafa, maslan NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se): CH₃CHO + 2[H] → CH₃CH₂OH. Baqi teen alcohols ki oxidation hain (1° → aldehyde, 2° → ketone, 1° → carboxylic acid).

blocks.prompt:
VI. Dehydration of alcohol is an example of
(Alcohol ki dehydration kis qisam ka reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dehydration elimination reaction hai jis mein pani ka molecule (β-carbon ka H aur –OH) nikal kar alkene banti hai: CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
VII. Bromine reacts with phenol and decolourise orange color and turns it to which of the colored precipitate?
(Bromine phenol se react kar ke orange rang khatam karti hai aur kis rang ka precipitate banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenol room temperature par orange bromine water ka rang khatam karta hai aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safed precipitate deta hai: C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃OH + 3HBr.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. When phenol is treated with excess bromine water it gives m-bromophenol?
(Phenol ko zyada bromine water ke saath milane par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: –OH group ring ko activate karta hai aur electrophile ko 2, 4 aur 6 positions par bhejta hai. Zyada bromine water se teeno jagah substitution hota hai: C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → 2,4,6-tribromophenol (safed ppt) + 3HBr. m-Bromophenol nahi banta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal ghalat chhapa hai: aakhir mein “it gives m-bromophenol?” likha hai jaise haan/nahi ka sawal ho, aur sirf teen options (a–c) chhape hain. Sawal yeh hona chahiye ke phenol zyada bromine water se kya deta hai; jawab 2,4,6-tribromophenol hai, m-bromophenol nahi.

blocks.prompt:
IX. What are the correct reagents for the conversion below?
CH₃CH₂CHOHCH₃ → CH₃CH₂CHBrCH₃
(Neeche di gayi tabdeeli ke liye sahi reagents kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation:
–OH ki jagah Br aata hai. NaBr (KBr ki tarah) H₂SO₄ ke saath flask mein HBr banata hai, jo alcohol ko bromoalkane mein badalta hai:
CH₃CH₂CH(OH)CH₃ + NaBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃CH₂CHBrCH₃ + NaHSO₄ + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
X. Give a chemical test used in distinguishing propan-1-ol and propan-2-ol.
(Propan-1-ol aur propan-2-ol mein farq karne ka chemical test kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Propan-2-ol mein CH₃–CH(OH)– group hai, is liye halogen aur NaOH ke saath yeh propanone ban kar haloform reaction deta hai; propan-1-ol nahi deta. Yahi murad jawab hai. Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ dono ke saath green hota hai (dono oxidise hote hain), SOCl₂ dono ko chloroalkane banata hai, aur NaOH(aq) kisi se react nahi karta. Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Aam test iodoform test hai jo I₂ aur NaOH se hota hai (Chapter 23 mein): propan-2-ol tri-iodomethane (CHI₃) ka peela precipitate deta hai, propan-1-ol nahi. Br₂ aur NaOH se bromoform banta hai jo liquid hai, is liye saaf precipitate nazar nahi aata. Option (a) murad jawab ke tor par rakha gaya; is mein “I₂ and NaOH” hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
a) Six alcohols are given below:
i. butan-2-ol  ii. ethane-1,2-diol  iii. 2-methylpentan-3-ol  iv. 2-methylpropan-2-ol  v. propan-1-ol  vi. propan-2-ol
i) Which alcohol is an example of a tertiary alcohol?
ii) Which alcohol is an example of an alcohol that can be oxidized to carboxylic acid?.
iii) Which alcohol is an example of an alcohol that can be oxidized to a ketone?
v) Which alcohol can't change color of acidified potassium dichromate?
Chhe alcohols diye gaye hain. Batayein: tertiary alcohol kaun sa; kaun sa carboxylic acid tak oxidise hota hai; kaun sa ketone tak; aur kaun sa acidified potassium dichromate ka rang nahi badalta.
blocks.explanation:
i) iv. 2-methylpropan-2-ol, (CH₃)₃COH (OH wala carbon teen carbons se juda).
ii) v. propan-1-ol (primary): CH₃CH₂CH₂OH → [O] propanal → [O] propanoic acid, CH₃CH₂COOH.
iii) Secondary alcohol: vi. propan-2-ol → propanone (i. butan-2-ol aur iii. 2-methylpentan-3-ol bhi).
v) iv. 2-methylpropan-2-ol: tertiary alcohol oxidise nahi hota, is liye orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ orange hi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Q2(a) ke hisson ki numbering i), ii), iii), v) hai: iv) numbering mein ghayab hai (koi sawal kam nahi).

blocks.prompt:
b) Phenylamine reacts with HNO₂(aq) at 4°C to form compound P. Compound P reacts with phenol under alkaline conditions at 4°C. The product of this reaction is acidified, forming azo compound Q.
i) Draw the structure of compound P and Q.
ii) Circle the azo group on your structure.
iii) State one use of an azo compound such as Q.
Phenylamine 4°C par HNO₂ se P banata hai; P alkaline halaat mein phenol se react karta hai aur acidify karne par azo compound Q banta hai. P aur Q ke structures, azo group, aur Q jaise azo compound ka aik istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
i) P = benzenediazonium chloride, C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻: benzene ring jis se –N⁺≡N (diazonium group) juda hai, saath Cl⁻.
C₆H₅NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + 2H₂O (10 °C se kam)
Q = 4-hydroxyazobenzene, C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₄–OH: aik benzene ring –N=N– ke zariye doosri ring se judi hai jis par para (4) position par –OH hai.
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + C₆H₅OH → C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₄OH + HCl
ii) Do rings ko jorne wala –N=N– azo group hai.
iii) Azo compounds rangeen hote hain aur dyes (azo dyes) ke tor par istemal hote hain; –N=N– group chromophore (rang dene wala group) hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Diazonium salt sirf thande (10 °C se kam) mein stable hai; garam hone par N₂ gas de kar toot jata hai. Phenol ke saath coupling para position par hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) Cyclohexane can be converted into cyclohexene via a three stage synthesis.
(Scheme: cyclohexane → stage 1, Cl₂ → compound A → stage 2 → cyclohexanol → stage 3 → cyclohexene.)
i) In stage 1, cyclohexane reacts with chlorine to form the organic product, compound A. Show the structure of compound A.
ii) Stage 3 involves the dehydration of an alcohol. State a suitable reagent for dehydrating an alcohol.
iii) Write a balanced equation for the dehydration of cyclohexanol, C₆H₁₁OH.
Cyclohexane teen marhalon mein cyclohexene banta hai. A ka structure, dehydration ka reagent, aur cyclohexanol ki dehydration ki balanced equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) A = chlorocyclohexane, C₆H₁₁Cl: chhe carbons ki ring (paanch CH₂ aur aik CH) jis mein CH carbon par Cl hai. C₆H₁₂ + Cl₂ → (roshni) C₆H₁₁Cl + HCl (free-radical substitution). Stage 2: A ko aqueous NaOH ke saath garam karein → cyclohexanol.
ii) Concentrated H₂SO₄ (ya concentrated H₃PO₄, ya garam Al₂O₃).
iii) C₆H₁₁OH → (conc. H₂SO₄, garmi) C₆H₁₀ + H₂O

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chhape hue scheme mein cyclohexanol ko “cyclohexannol” likha hai (spelling ghalat), aur stage 1 par sirf Cl₂ likha hai; alkane ki chlorination ke liye roshni (UV) bhi zaroori hai.

d) C₄H₁₀O ke chaar structural isomer alcohols A, B, C, D diye gaye hain.
(Jaise chhape: A = CH₃–C(CH₃)₂–OH; B = CH₃–CH₂–C(CH₃)₂–OH; C = CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–OH; D = CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–OH.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Structure B paanch carbons ke saath chhapa hai, CH₃–CH₂–C(CH₃)₂–OH (2-methylbutan-2-ol, C₅H₁₂O), is liye yeh C₄H₁₀O ka isomer nahi. C₄H₁₀O ka chautha alcohol butan-2-ol, CH₃–CH(OH)–CH₂–CH₃ (secondary) hai, jo shayad murad tha. Neeche jawab dono soorton mein diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
i) Identify the type of alcohol represented by A and by B.
A aur B kis qisam ke alcohols hain?
blocks.explanation: A tertiary alcohol hai: C–OH wala carbon teen carbons se juda hai. Chhapa hua B bhi tertiary hai (C–OH teen carbons se juda); agar B butan-2-ol ho (murad C₄H₁₀O isomer) to woh secondary hai.

blocks.prompt:
ii) Give the name of alcohol A.
Alcohol A ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: A, (CH₃)₃C–OH, 2-methylpropan-2-ol hai.

blocks.prompt:
iii) Select one of the alcohols A, B, C or D which will, on oxidation, produce an aldehyde. Give the structural formula of the aldehyde produced by this reaction.
A, B, C ya D mein se kaun sa oxidation par aldehyde deta hai? Aldehyde ka structural formula likhein.
blocks.explanation:
C (butan-1-ol), primary alcohol: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO (butanal) + H₂O.
(D bhi primary hai, 2-methylpropanal, (CH₃)₂CH–CHO, deta hai.)

blocks.prompt:
iv) All the alcohols A, B, C and D may be readily dehydrated. Explain what is meant by the term dehydration. State the type of compound formed by dehydration of alcohols.
Dehydration se kya muraad hai? Alcohols ki dehydration se kis qisam ka compound banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dehydration elimination reaction hai jis mein alcohol se pani ka aik molecule (–OH aur saath wale β-carbon ka H) nikalta hai. Is se alkene banti hai, maslan CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
v) Suggest suitable reagent(s) and condition(s) for the dehydration of alcohols.
Alcohols ki dehydration ke liye munasib reagent aur halaat batayein.
blocks.explanation: Alcohol ko zyada concentrated H₂SO₄ ya concentrated H₃PO₄ ke saath garam karein, ya alcohol ke bukharat ko garam aluminium oxide (Al₂O₃) par se guzarein.

blocks.prompt:
e) Select one of the alcohols A, B, C or D which, on dehydration, would give a single product. Draw the structural formula of this product.
A, B, C ya D mein se kaun sa dehydration par sirf aik product deta hai? Us ka structural formula likhein.
blocks.explanation:
A, 2-methylpropan-2-ol: teeno β-carbons aik jaise CH₃ groups hain, is liye sirf aik alkene banti hai:
(CH₃)₃C–OH → CH₂=C(CH₃)₂ (2-methylpropene) + H₂O
Structure: C=C double bond; aik carbon par do H atoms, doosre par do CH₃ groups. (D bhi sirf 2-methylpropene deta hai. Chhapa hua B, ya butan-2-ol, ke do mukhtalif β-carbons hain, is liye mixture deta hai.)

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab likhein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Why nitration of phenol is easier than benzene. Which product is formed when phenol is nitrated with conc. HNO₃ at room temperature?
Phenol ki nitration benzene se aasaan kyun hai? Room temperature par conc. HNO₃ se phenol ki nitration se kya banta hai?
blocks.explanation:
–OH ki oxygen ka aik lone pair benzene ring mein phail jata hai aur ring ki electron density barha deta hai; ring activated ho jati hai, is liye electrophile NO₂⁺ narm halaat (dilute HNO₃, room temperature) mein 2, 4, 6 positions par aasani se hamla karta hai. Benzene ko conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄, 25–60 °C chahiye.
Conc. HNO₃ se: 2,4,6-trinitrophenol. C₆H₅OH + 3HNO₃ → C₆H₂(NO₂)₃OH + 3H₂O

blocks.prompt:
ii. Sodium hydroxide reacts with phenol but not with ethanol. Give reason.
Sodium hydroxide phenol se react karta hai magar ethanol se nahi. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Phenol zyada taqatwar acid hai (pani se bhi): phenoxide ion ka negative charge ring mein phail kar use stable kar deta hai, is liye yeh OH⁻ ko H⁺ de deta hai: C₆H₅OH + NaOH → C₆H₅ONa + H₂O. Ethanol pani se kamzor acid hai; electron dene wala ethyl group (+I) ethoxide ion ko unstable karta hai, is liye OH⁻ is ka proton nahi le sakta.

blocks.prompt:
iii. Give reactions of methanol with SOCl₂, and PCl₅.
Methanol ke SOCl₂ aur PCl₅ ke saath reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation:
CH₃OH + SOCl₂ → (pyridine) CH₃Cl + SO₂ + HCl
CH₃OH + PCl₅ → CH₃Cl + POCl₃ + HCl
Dono mein –OH ki jagah Cl aa kar chloromethane banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
iv. How propanol can be converted into propanal?
Propanol ko propanal mein kaise badla jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Propan-1-ol (primary alcohol) ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise karein; orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ green Cr³⁺ ban jata hai:
CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + [O] → (H⁺/K₂Cr₂O₇) CH₃CH₂CHO + H₂O
Aldehyde bante hi distil kar ke nikal liya jata hai taake aage propanoic acid na ban jaye (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
v. Write down the reaction for the substitution of each of Cl, Br, and I with –OH in 2-propanol.
2-propanol mein –OH ki jagah Cl, Br aur I lane ke reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Cl: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + HCl → (ZnCl₂) CH₃CHClCH₃ + H₂O
Br: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃CHBrCH₃ + KHSO₄ + H₂O
I: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + KI + H₃PO₄ → CH₃CHICH₃ + KH₂PO₄ + H₂O
(Iodoalkanes ke liye H₃PO₄ is liye ke yeh kamzor oxidizing agent hai aur I⁻ ko I₂ nahi banata.)

blocks.prompt:
vi. Construct a reaction for the preparation of nitro-substituted naphthol. Is there produced a single product? Explain.
Nitro-substituted naphthol banane ka reaction likhein. Kya sirf aik product banta hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
1-naphthol + dilute HNO₃ (room temperature) → 2-nitro-1-naphthol + 4-nitro-1-naphthol + H₂O
C₁₀H₇OH + HNO₃ → C₁₀H₆(NO₂)OH + H₂O
Nahi, mixture banta hai: –OH group naphthalene ring ko activate karta hai aur electrophile ko 2 aur 4 dono positions par bhejta hai (9 aur 10 par H nahi).

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Explain the acidity of phenol
Phenol ki acidity ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Phenol, C₆H₅OH, halka sa acidic hai: pani mein yeh apne –OH group se thoda sa proton chhorta hai.
C₆H₅OH(aq) ⇌ C₆H₅O⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq)
Wajah: phenoxide ion ki oxygen ka aik lone pair benzene ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai. Is liye negative charge oxygen par rehne ke bajaye ring par (2, 4 aur 6 carbons tak) phail jata hai. Yeh delocalisation phenoxide ion (conjugate base) ko stable karta hai. Oxygen par charge density kam hone se H⁺ wapas zyada nahi kheencha jata, is liye phenol proton lene ke bajaye proton chhorne (acid banne) ki taraf mail hai.
Muqabla: alcohol mein alkyl group electron deta hai (+I effect); yeh alkoxide ion ki oxygen par electron density barha kar use unstable karta hai, is liye alcohols pani se kam ionise hote hain. Acidity ki tarteeb: phenol > water > ethanol.
Saboot:
1. Phenol NaOH mein hal ho kar salt aur pani banata hai (ethanol nahi): C₆H₅OH + NaOH → C₆H₅ONa + H₂O
2. Pighla hua phenol sodium se tezi se react kar ke H₂ deta hai: 2C₆H₅OH + 2Na → 2C₆H₅ONa + H₂
Bari non-polar benzene ring ki wajah se phenol pani mein kam hal hota hai, magar alkaline solutions mein hal pazeer phenoxide salt ban kar ghul jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Conjugate base jitna zyada stable, acid utna zyada taqatwar. Phenoxide ka charge ring par phail kar stable ho jata hai; ethoxide ka charge oxygen par jama rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain why the reagents and conditions for the nitration and bromination of phenol are different from those for benzene.
Phenol ki nitration aur bromination ke reagents aur halaat benzene se mukhtalif kyun hain? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Phenol mein –OH group benzene ring se juda hai. Oxygen ka aik lone pair ring ke π system se overlap kar ke phail jata hai, is liye ring ki electron density barh jati hai. Ring activated ho jati hai aur benzene ke muqable mein electrophiles is par bohat aasani se hamla karte hain; –OH group electrophile ko 2, 4 aur 6 positions par bhejta hai. Is liye narm reagents kaafi hain, aur aksar teeno positions par substitution ho jata hai.
Nitration:
Benzene: conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄, 25–60 °C par reflux → nitrobenzene.
Phenol: dilute HNO₃ room temperature par → 2-nitrophenol + 4-nitrophenol; conc. HNO₃ se → 2,4,6-trinitrophenol.
Bromination:
Benzene: khalis bromine (solution nahi) aur anhydrous AlBr₃ catalyst, room temperature → bromobenzene.
Phenol: bromine water, catalyst nahi, room temperature; orange rang khatam aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safed precipitate: C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃OH + 3HBr.

rows: –OH ke lone pair se ring activated (zyada electron density)
Nitration: conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄, reflux 25–60 °C
Bromination: bromine water, catalyst nahi, room temperature
Bromination: khalis Br₂ aur anhydrous AlBr₃ catalyst

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Describe how phenylamine can be converted into phenol, including reagents and conditions.
Phenylamine ko phenol mein kaise badla jata hai? Reagents aur halaat ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh tabdeeli diazonium salt ke zariye teen qadmon mein hoti hai.
Qadam 1 (nitrous acid wahin banana): HNO₂ unstable hai, is liye test tube mein sodium nitrite aur dilute hydrochloric acid se banaya jata hai, barf se 10 °C se kam rakh kar:
NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl
Qadam 2 (diazotisation, 10 °C se kam): phenylamine HNO₂ aur HCl se benzenediazonium chloride banata hai:
C₆H₅NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + 2H₂O
Kam temperature is liye zaroori hai ke diazonium salt unstable hai aur room temperature par bhi N₂ de kar toot jata hai.
Qadam 3 (hydrolysis): diazonium salt ke solution ko pani ke saath garam kiya jata hai; nitrogen gas nikalti hai aur phenol banta hai:
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → (garam) C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Explain why ethanol is less acidic than water, but water is less acidic than phenol.
Ethanol pani se kam acidic kyun hai, aur pani phenol se kam acidic kyun hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Acidity is par munhasir hai ke H⁺ kitni aasani se nikalta hai, yani peeche bachne wala ion (conjugate base) kitna stable hai.
CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂O⁻ + H⁺   H₂O ⇌ OH⁻ + H⁺   C₆H₅OH ⇌ C₆H₅O⁻ + H⁺
Ethanol < pani: ethyl group electron deta hai (positive inductive effect, +I). Yeh ethoxide ion ki oxygen par electron density barhata hai, is liye negative charge zyada jama ho jata hai aur ion unstable hota hai. CH₃CH₂O⁻ aasani se H⁺ wapas le kar ethanol ban jata hai, is liye ethanol mein [H⁺] pani se kam hai. Saboot: sodium ethanol ke saath pani se kam tezi se react karta hai (phenolphthalein ke saath ethanol mein gulabi rang aahista, pani mein foran).
Pani < phenol: phenoxide ion mein oxygen ka aik lone pair benzene ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai, is liye negative charge ring par phail jata hai. Is se C₆H₅O⁻ stable hota hai aur oxygen par charge density kam ho jati hai, is liye H⁺ wapas zyada nahi kheencha jata. Is liye phenol pani se zyada aasani se H⁺ chhorta hai; yeh NaOH se bhi react karta hai: C₆H₅OH + NaOH → C₆H₅ONa + H₂O.
Acidity ki tarteeb: phenol > water > ethanol.
